##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 29 April 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred close to northeast Scotland extends a ridge covering much of Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

East 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 this evening and at first tonight, possibly touching 7 in southwest of area for a time. Continuing East 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, decreasing East or Southeast 4 or 5 in afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or Southeast 4 or 5, decreasing Southeast 3 or 4 on Friday morning, then South or Southeast 2 or 3 in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight.


##Weather##

Fair, isolated showers later.


##Visibility##

Good.
